name: NCAA D-I Great Lakes Regional Cross Country Championships
where: East Lansing, MI · host Michigan State · Forest Akers
headline: NCAA D-I Great Lakes Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 15 Toledo went 1-2-3 behind Karina James (19:55.2) and won the women’s race with 31 points over No. 13 Notre Dame (60). Toledo’s men also won, 59 to 66 over No. 16 Notre Dame, with Michigan State third (106) and No. 12 Wisconsin fourth (109). Butler’s William Zegarski won the men’s race in 29:55.0.
